name: Condensed Milk
siboNotes: High lactose content makes this problematic for SIBO patients. Even small amounts may trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Use sparingly in recipes - a little goes a long way for sweetness
Can be diluted with lactose-free milk to reduce concentration
Consider using in baking where lactose may be partially broken down
Store opened cans in refrigerator and use within 3-4 days
alternatives: Homemade lactose-free condensed milk using lactose-free milk
Maple syrup mixed with lactose-free milk powder
Rice malt syrup for sweetening applications
nutritionalHighlights: Very high in sugar and calories
